fusions.name: Echo Down the Haft
fusions.desc: Sends a pulse of sound that deals 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Night Gleaning
fusions.desc: A reaching strike on a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Ranging Cry
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.2 times as far.

fusions.name: Lapped Dry
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your hits heal you for 20% of their damage for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
